text: *Bablu*, 21, from Kanpur. B.Tech third year, four backlogs. His Gurugram internship starts in *11 days*, but every society in NCR says *No Bachelors*. The RWAs want *police verification*, stamped at the *Sarkari Daftar*. One flat. One stamp. 11 days. If Bablu dies, the lease is terminated.
An *Astrologer Baba* outside the metro station grabs your hand. "Your stars are aligned, beta. Temporarily."
picked by the enemy group rolled that day) ---
A *Wrong-Side Scooty Uncle* is driving straight at you. On the footpath. Against traffic. Honking at *you*.
He reverses into oncoming traffic, unbothered. Nobody is surprised.
An *auto bhaiya* pulls up, looks you up and down, and says the four most powerful words in Delhi: *Meter se nahi jayenge.*
He agrees to go "by meter". The meter has been broken since 2004.
A *South Delhi Girl* has blocked the footpath for a boomerang. "Like, literally, can you move? This is *content*."
She posts your fight with the caption "humble beginnings". It gets 2.3k likes. You get none.
Welcome to the *Noida Free Trade Zone*. A *Monkey Gang* guards the expressway exit. One of them is wearing someone's office ID card.
The monkeys retreat to a balcony with your sunglasses. They will be back. They always come back.
Your cab driver is lost in the *sector maze*. Somehow it's your fault. "Sir, aapne *63* bola tha!"
You reach your destination. It was *Sector 62* all along. Or was it?
A *Firecracker Ban Violator* is launching rockets "for the culture". The *Society Guard* wants to know: "Kahan jaana hai?"
The guard finally lets you through the gate. You were trying to leave.
Welcome to the *Gurugram Corporate Emirates*. A *LinkedIn Tech Bro* blocks the Cyber Hub entrance. "Let's take this offline. Also, are you open to work?"
He updates his headline to "Humbled. Learning from failure." It gets 9k likes. You get endorsed for Violence.
*Rajiv Chowk*, 6 PM. The doors open and you are *transferred* inside. A *PDA couple* has claimed the only door. Your stop is next.
The couple breaks up mid-fight, gets back together at Mandi House, and posts about it. You make your stop. Barely.
*The Noida society gate.* The RWA has called an emergency meeting about *you*. Chairing it: *Pinky Aunty*. Her WiFi works now. She no longer needs you.
Pinky Aunty retreats to draft a 47-paragraph WhatsApp forward about this. The guard lets you through. Your head is cold.
*Pinky Aunty* from the RWA WhatsApp group corners you at the gate. "Beta, I will help you. But first forward this to 10 people."
result_a: *Pinky Aunty* joins you! You are now in 14 new WhatsApp groups.
result_b: She joins anyway, and tells the whole society you are "very rude". *Pinky Aunty* joins you!

text: The *Broker* appears. "Sir, small matter only. One month brokerage, one month deposit, one month *documentation charges*."
The Broker drops his phone. He was on a call with another tenant the whole time. He hands you a *temporary address proof*.
*Lalaji*, CEO of *Lalaji & Sons Pvt. Ltd.* (a startup since 1972), blocks your path with his bahi-khata. "Intern! Culture-fit round. Now."
Lalaji shuts the bahi-khata. "Profit is temporary, beta. Family is forever." Bunty writes you down as a loss.
A *chai tapri* outside the Daftar. *Delivery Wale Bhaiya* calls: "Sir, 2 minute mein pahunch raha hoon." He said that on Day 1.
result_a: Kadak chai. Full HP. For one moment, everything is fine.
result_b: You burn your tongue. Now you are furious, which helps.

text: The *Babu*, Keeper of the Stamp, looks up. "Original + 3 photocopies + self-attested + attested by gazetted officer + your soul."
THUNK. The *stamp* lands: *POLICE VERIFICATION, VALID FOR 11 MONTHS*. Bablu is officially a person. For 11 months.
A *barricade* blocks the road. *Maamu* stands next to it. "Road closed temporarily, sir." "Since when?" "2011."
result_a: The detour has its own detour. You learn a lot about yourself.
result_b: He issues you a *₹100 challan* for arguing. You leave angrier, and somehow stronger.

text: *Sarojini Nagar*. A shopkeeper holds up a t-shirt. "Last price, 500." The tag says 50. The shirt says "Gucii".
result_a: You walk away. He chases you for two lanes. 80 rupees. You have learnt *Haggling*.
result_b: You overpaid, but the shopkeeper blesses you and your future children. +Max HP.

text: *Rajiv Chowk* metro, 6pm. The doors open. You do not get on the train. You are *transferred* onto it.
result_a: You get off at a station you've never heard of. Character development.
result_b: You win a seat. An uncle gives you a look that will haunt you.

text: A *chole bhature* stall at 11am. Each bhatura is the size of your head. Your doctor is on speed dial.
result_a: You can't move for 20 minutes, but your body adapts. +Max HP.
result_b: The stall owner is offended. You feel light and healthy, and slightly ashamed.

text: A house party in *GK-2*. Someone asks "So what do you *do*?" before asking your name.
result_a: Someone hires you as a consultant on the spot. +₹100. Everyone nods. Nobody asks a follow-up question. You blend in perfectly.
result_b: Gasps. Someone offers you a kombucha out of pity. Shame is a kind of armour.

text: *Hauz Khas Village*. Every café has the same fairy lights and a guy with a guitar playing Wonderwall.
result_a: He plays it. The crowd turns on you, then joins in. You feel like a hero.
result_b: You escape before the second chorus. Some battles are not worth fighting.

text: A *baraat* has blocked all six lanes of the expressway. The band has been playing the same song for 40 minutes.
result_a: You dance like nobody is watching. Everybody is watching. Your legs are stronger now.
result_b: It takes three hours. But you are wiser, and you now know all the words.

text: The *DND Flyway*. It's been toll-free for years, but every car still slows down at the old toll booth. Out of respect.
result_a: You blast through. Twelve people honk at you for breaking tradition.
result_b: You slow down. You don't know why. You are becoming one of them.

text: You need *Sector 62*. Google says left. A local uncle says right. The sign says *Sector 63, also 62*.
result_a: You arrive at *Sector 16*. It's fine. Everything here is "nearby".
result_b: He walks you there himself, and tells you his son's JEE rank. Twice.

text: *Sector 18* market. A mall, a metro station, and a parking lot that hasn't had a free spot since 2009.
result_a: Forty minutes later you find a spot. In Sector 19.
result_b: You get towed. ₹100 to get it back. You chase the tow truck anyway. Excellent cardio.

text: A *Noida Extension* builder grabs your arm. "Flat, sir. Possession in 6 months. Guaranteed." The brochure is from 2014.
result_a: ₹150 token amount. Possession date: *2031*. But the brochure is very glossy. You feel invested.
result_b: You escape. He shouts the EMI amount after you. It echoes.

text: A shoot at *Noida Film City*. The director needs an extra who looks "confused and new to the city". You are perfect.
result_a: They pay you ₹150. Your face is on screen for 0.4 seconds. Your mother tells everyone.
result_b: Your line: "Bhaiya, yeh Sector 62 hai?" They print it in one take.

text: The *photocopy shop* outside the Daftar. The Babu wants "original plus copies". Of what? Nobody knows.
result_a: Self-attested, stapled, laminated. You feel bureaucratically armoured.
result_b: You hold the only original. The power is intoxicating.

text: The *token machine* prints number *847*. The screen says "Now serving: 12".
result_a: You take a nap on the bench. Full HP. Now serving: 13.
result_b: ₹100 for chai-paani. A peon takes you to the front for "chai-paani". You feel powerful, and a little guilty.

text: You need *Form 16-B*, which needs *Form 16-A*, which is only issued after you submit *Form 16-B*.
result_a: You have broken the loop. Somewhere, a clerk feels a disturbance.
result_b: Nothing is solved, but everything is waterproof now.

*JhatPat* is installed on your phone: weapons, chai and a *Mystery Box*, delivered in 10 minutes (T&C apply). Mummy sent *₹200* pocket money. *Welcome offer: your first Mystery Box is FREE.* Tap the JhatPat app after any day.
*Rent day.* The landlord takes *₹{rs}*. He does not care about the baraat.
*Sirhaul toll plaza.* Welcome to Gurugram. The toll is 30 seconds long and 40 minutes deep. *Toll Tax: all stats -15% for 2 days.*
*DND Flyway.* It has been toll-free for years. The *Toll Tax* still applies, out of respect. *All stats -15% for 2 days.*
*Delhi border.* An MCD man with a receipt book appears from nowhere. *Toll Tax: all stats -15% for 2 days.*
Your *FASTag* beeps. The boom barrier opens. For one moment, you understand what it feels like to be rich. *No Toll Tax.*
*Daaru Uncle* has joined you! He sleeps outside the Cyber Hub fountain and knows every shortcut. He throws bottles. Mostly at enemies.
*Sheru* the street dog has joined you! You gave him half a samosa. He is now yours, forever, or until the border.
*Kush* from the rival uni has joined you. Tier-1. He will share his notes. He will also remind you he is Tier-1.
*Pinky Aunty* stays back in Dilli for a kitty party. "Beta, call me." You will not.
*Daaru Uncle* stays at the toll plaza. He has made friends with the boom barrier.
*Sheru* stops at the Delhi border. Noida dogs do not cross borders. He watches you go. You are not crying, it is the smog.
*Delivery Wale Bhaiya* finally arrives. "Sir, your order." You placed it 11 months ago.
